# Supabase JavaScript SDK

`supabase-2.118.0.js` is the unmodified UMD build from the official `@supabase/supabase-js@2.118.0` npm package. Source: https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js. License: MIT. Vendored for reliable offline app loading; no service-role or Google client secret belongs in this directory.
